title: HOW TO JOIN FORSAGE WITH TRUST WALLET (Quickest method)
description: To join Forsage using TRUST WALLET from your mobile device, please follow the above instructions.

asr.full_text: Okay, in this video, I'm going to show you how you can use Trust Wallet to start your Versailles business. The first thing to do is click on the four squares at the bottom. That will bring you to this page. Then you need to put in the link from the person who referred you to Versailles. Once you do that, that will bring you to the actual for such page so you click on registration and make sure the ID number is from the person that sent you the link then you click register that will show you the giant fee when you first start which is point zero two five for the x3 and zero point point two, five for the X3 and 0.025 for the X4 and the network fee then includes the X3 and the X4 so make sure you have enough funds in your Trust Wallet to start. so that's it

annotation.contextual_rationale: The video provides a joining tutorial for Forsage that directs viewers to use a referrer's link and ID, open registration, and proceed toward payment through Trust Wallet. It states that starting requires specified X3 and X4 amounts plus a network fee, while the displayed wallet confirmation shows a 0.05 ETH outgoing amount and a substantially larger network fee. These sources support a concrete referral-linked cryptocurrency registration and payment flow, although they do not establish that a transaction was approved, who received funds, or what participants would receive.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 is the best-grounded supplied subtype because the registration flow explicitly depends on a referrer's link and ID, and the supplied registration frame displays an Upline field. The evidence supports a referral/upline-linked paid expansion structure, although it does not explicitly establish commissions, downline income, or tier qualification.
